heard: The inevitable crash of our galaxy is actually a coin flip. For over a century, astronomers warned the Milky Way would inevitably smash into the Andromeda galaxy. Andromeda is currently hurtling toward us at 110 kilometers per second. A 2025 study led by Tilsawalla used up to 100,000 simulations to test this fate. It turns out the large Magellanic cloud acts like a cosmic bodyguard, pulling us off the impact course. Data from the Hubble and Gaia telescopes now show only a 50% chance of merging. The chance of a head-on collision in 5 billion years is now estimated at just 2%. New calculations suggest the famous galactic crash is far from certain.
differences: 'till sawala' heard as 'tilsawalla' after 'study led by'
